text:
Maria Cortez: Quick heads-up — cohort A day-1 (Mon) logistics: 3 new hires. One has an expired passport (intl) which blocks I-9; one has BG pending (vendor ETA 48–72h); third is good. Need plan for benefits drop-in, mobile notary slot for ID, and laptop courier. Who can triage?
Sam Patel: I can run notary coordination. @Peggy — can we reserve 12:30–13:15 mobile notary for the intl hire and a benefits drop-in 14:00–15:00 in Commons B?
Peggy - People Ops: Yes. I'll book mobile notary through NotaryNow. Quick Q: do we accept passport OR EAD OR driver+SSN combo for I-9 in this scenario? Also, can we defer I-9 until Day 3 if courier plan works?
Jordan Lee: Reminder: remote I-9 allowed only with authorized notary + scans. If passport expired, hire needs renewal OR provide driver’s license + SSN card/mail tax doc. BG vendor says can start contingent; manager sign-off needed for systems access.
Sam Patel: Manager approves contingent start for 48h. I'll create the `benefits-dropin` calendar invite. Peggy — DM me the NotaryNow booking link and I'll ping the hire.
Peggy - People Ops: Booking link: https://notarynow.example/book/slot123
Peggy - People Ops: Also adding fallback: HR desk in-office 09:00–11:00 Tue for any walk-ins.
people-ops-bot: Reminder created — room booked: Commons B (14:00-15:00), Mobile Notary: 12:30. Reference #ONBOARD-4721
Maria Cortez: For BG: vendor ETA ~48h; if not cleared by Wed morning we restrict access. Sam — can you coordinate laptop courier? Need recipient details.
Sam Patel: Courier instructions:
```
Recipient: Amir Hassan
Phone: +1-415-555-0199
Alt contact: Jordan Lee +1-415-555-0101
Note: Leave at security if not home, call first.
```
Jordan Lee: Benefits drop-in checklist (to hand out):
- Bring SSN card or recent tax doc
- Signed benefits packet
- Completed direct deposit form
I'll upload materials to Drive and paste link in mailer: https://drive.example/r/welcome-kit
Maria Cortez: Can Amir confirm the notary slot? Sam please ping him now. I'll also add an Okta access exception for contingent start.
Sam Patel: Pinged Amir via SMS + email. He replied: "12:30 works, passport renewal in progress — will bring driver's + SSN"
Peggy - People Ops: Noted. We'll proceed with mobile notary + I-9 using driver's license + SSN as alternate docs per policy. Logging exception: "I-9 alternate docs accepted once pending passport renewal." I'll record it in HRIS.
Maria Cortez: Final Day-1 checklist to send to manager:
```
- Mobile notary 12:30 (I-9 w/ driver’s license + SSN)
- Benefits drop-in 14:00 Commons B
- Laptop courier scheduled Mon a.m.
- BG monitoring: restrict SSO if not cleared by Wed 10:00
- Manager to approve contingent tasks (confirm via email)
```
Thanks team :raised_hands:
